notes.title: [Patch 2020.06.19]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36928553/8f25703a1733b987443f8a275c0245633e958201.jpg[/img]

[b]Add New Game+[/b]
-After clearing the game, Start the game again in New Game+ allows the selection of Hard Difficulty Mode and any equipments and upgrades made will remain.
(If you have cleared before this patch, load the existing save data and defeat the last boss again to unlock the New Game+ mode.)

[b]Add Hard Difficulty Mode[/b]
-The enemies will be stronger/faster/more aggressive and the traps damage will increase in Hard Difficulty Mode.
-An additional Achievement has been added.

[b]Improve Air Mark Attack and Spell controll[/b]
-Improved Mark Attack controll to make it easier to use in the air.
-Improved controll to use Spell during an attack or in the air.

notes.title: [Patch 2020.06.08]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36928553/97c2eb57339ef9cc678d97c34e27d3a8898e2eb2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36928553/ff807a6b33c99b6b53d28048c748230ccb789b37.jpg[/img]

-When entering the stage, hidden items in the stage will be displayed.
-When exiting from the stage, items obtained from the stage and missed items are displayed.

-Bosses event cut scenes added.
-The [b]Counter Attack Passive Rune[/b] added.
-An [b]Achievement[/b] related to the Passive Rune added.

[b][Next Patch Plan][/b]

[b]Add New Game Plus[/b]
-After clearing the game, you can start a new game with the saved data.

[b]Add Hard Mode[/b]
-The enemies will be stronger/faster/more aggressive and the traps damage will increase.

[b]Add Chinese[/b]

notes.title: [Patch 2020.05.25]
notes.content:
[Patch Note_v20200525] 2020.05.25
[b]-Fixed bugs that cannot proceed with the stage in a specific language OS. (Russian/Netherlands)
[/b]

First of all, we apologize for the inconvenience.
I patched a bug that disappears when the level is restarted after getting the color rune.
and we also confirmed that the game can be cleared on the Russian version of
Windows 7 with our game version 20200525.
Before you play game with our game version 20200525.
******Please delete the All save file before playing the game.! (you can delete below forder.)*******

C:\Users\"username"\AppData\LocalLow\UltramarineSoft\KarmaKnight

Please enjoy the game again. Thank you so much!
